# The recorded class of each real-binary probe (tests/test_scope_probe_client.py).
# Re-observed on signed client 2.1.302 (linux-x64), 2026-10-18.
# PASS names an observed class, not a blanket capability or provider guarantee.
# A diagnostic probe whose new run differs reports 'changed recorded=<class>';
# the correctness-essential classes are asserted by the probes themselves.
client probe CE: PASS class=CE-A
client probe DAH: PASS class=DAH-override
client probe U1: PASS class=U1-proc
# U1/OC/RET pass on the private copied client. With the staged pin on a
# different filesystem from TMPDIR they report BOUNDARY (hardlink control).
# U1-c remains BOUNDARY on the private copy: no retained non-pinned sibling.
client probe X5: PASS class=X5-silent-hours
client probe SC: PASS class=SC-caps
client probe SX: PASS class=SX-open-continue-dies
client probe SF: PASS class=SF-lead-heavy
client probe RL: PASS class=RL-none
client probe RET: PASS class=RET-ok
client probe R19: PASS class=R19-closed
# R19: the compiled PreModelSwitch hook carries onFailure "block": a missing,
# non-executable, crashing or timed-out shim keeps the lead (without it the
# first three switch); deny and allow answers are unchanged. A shim exiting 0
# with a non-JSON answer gives no decision and the switch proceeds (the real
# shim answers its own deny on every failure).
client probe SK: PASS class=SK-kept
client probe OC: PASS class=OC-untouched
client probe FL: PASS class=FL-ok
client probe CC: PASS class=CC-bash-child
client probe FD: PASS class=FD-env-off-subagent-withheld
# FD: notify restores the lead; the subagent notify control is unavailable.
client probe XC: PASS class=XC-exact
client probe DG: PASS class=DG-resumable
# DG: 2.1.302 tool turn + /compact resumes on 2.1.292 with summary only.
client probe SL: BOUNDARY class=unavailable
# SL: no newer-than-pin client retained; not a successful resume observation.
# Supervisor takeover and staged marketplace-plugin updates remain INCONCLUSIVE
# offline. Signed real-provider behavior is not established by these fixtures.

# The session window and a cm-* agent's own window
# (tests/test_compaction_window_probe.py), signed client 2.1.302 linux-x64
# (binary sha256 60d7eb7f12fbb28a52533fe8be5884097403562aa02dc73991a021c7067e29a5,
# release manifest sha256 d7d4f193bfebb48733027b0dc43d6996d99f5335d152961a729730e55bbd5aa1),
# 2026-10-19, session window 800000 at 90 %:
compaction window probe: PASS class=settings-window-lowers-agents
# The window variable (the earlier compile) outranks an agent's own
# autoCompactWindow: a 128000 agent compacted at its 200K class, 162000. The
# settings key with the variable "0" in the flag-settings env: the lead at
# 702000; a 128000 agent window at 95000; 300000 on a 1M agent at 252000; no
# own window keeps 162000 and 702000; a window above the agent's class or
# below the 100K floor is ignored (162000); the lead and the agent hold
# against user, project and local top-level, per-model and env values and the
# process env, after /autocompact 300000, on --resume, and under --agent (the
# main thread keeps 702000). --autocompact passes the same offline cases; the
# client's /autocompact resets a --autocompact value to the settings in a
# running session (read from the build, not driven by these fixtures), so it
# is not compiled.
# The fence's cold start (protocol-3 shim plus a launcher answering premodel,
# 300 runs each, bytecode warm, 16 CPUs): CPython 3.14.6 p99 0.13 / 0.26 /
# 0.43 / 2.57 s at 0, 16, 32 and 64 CPU burners (max 3.33 s); CPython 3.15.0
# p99 0.17 / 0.45 / 1.75 / 3.47 s (max 4.31 s). Its budget is 15 s.
